name: k8s-dry-run
description: Turns kubectl apply into a server-side dry run with a diff you approve first.

prodPattern.title: Production context pattern
prodPattern.description: Regex (case-insensitive) matched against the kube context. Matching contexts fail closed and need the Approve button. Empty: prod, production, prd or live as a word.

timeoutSeconds.title: Dry-run timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long kubectl diff or the delete dry run may take.
